scenario: 手工建单 happy path — all required buyer/address/line/price present, build nested body + dry-run
input: 手工帮客户下个单：买 1 件 variant_id dd305ee4-fb07-4467-b846-27abd038f6ea，单价 19.99 英镑（GBP），运费 0，税 0，寄给 John Doe，邮箱 john@example.com，地址美国加州洛杉矶 123 Main St，加州 California，邮编 90012。

semantic_rubric: whole body nests under the required order wrapper; --data (not --params) carries it
line item: variant_id + quantity 1 + price 19.99 (all from the utterance, none fabricated)

shipping_address includes the required set (last_name Doe, email, country_code US, province California + province_code CA inferred, city Los Angeles, address, zip 90012) — codes are ISO, not display names
shipping_line present with shipping_price 0.00; shipping_name defaulted to a neutral label (e.g. Standard Shipping) — NOT blocked on and NOT asked for
tax_total 0.00 and currency_code GBP set from the utterance
money write: --dry-run first and restates the order before the real run

notes: POST /openapi/2026-01/orders. Required per schema orders.create: line_items[].quantity, shipping_address(last_name,email,country_code,province,province_code,city,address,zip), shipping_line(shipping_name,shipping_price), tax_total, currency_code. shipping_name is a display label the skill says to default, not ask — the fix for the triage over-ask.

input: 帮客户手工建一个订单。

ask_must_cover: variant|商品|买什么|买哪些|哪些商品|什么商品|货品|line item
地址|address|收货|shipping|买家|客户|email|邮箱|收件人
semantic_rubric: asks for the line item(s) — which variant(s) and quantity — and the buyer's shipping identity/address
does NOT emit an orders create command with an invented body
does not fabricate a customer, an address, a price, or a variant id
bundles the missing required fields into one question rather than asking serially

notes: Must-ask probe: no line items and no buyer/address given — all required no-default fields are missing.

scenario: no-fabricate guard — custom line has no price, buyer identity incomplete
input: 给客户手工建个单：一个定制礼品盒，数量 1，客户叫张伟。

ask_must_cover: price|价格|单价|多少钱|金额|售价
semantic_rubric: custom line item (定制礼品盒, no catalog variant) has no price source — asks for the price, does NOT fabricate one
buyer identity is only a name (张伟) — asks for the required email + shipping address, does NOT fabricate them
keeps 张伟 as the buyer name and quantity 1 from the utterance
does NOT emit an orders create command with an invented body

notes: No-fabricate probe for a required money field (custom-line price) and buyer identity. A custom line (product_title) has no variant to price it, so price is genuinely required and unstated.
